title: Derived fibres of the explicit canonical structure map
statement: Let f : X → S be a quasi-compact separated flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-weil-flat-morphism], with shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Put J = O_S[0], E = Rf_*(O_X[0]) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and a = single(f♯) followed by canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f O_X [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison]. For every s in S and i < 0, H^i(Li_s^* E) = 0 [def-pc-derived-pullback]. If the canonical ring map κ(s) → Γ(X_s,O_X_s) [def-pc-base-change] is invertible, then H^0(Li_s^* a) is invertible. The map a is this explicit canonical composite, not an arbitrary morphism J → E.

proof.text: Apply relative flat canonical module base change to O_X and the residue-field square. Flatness of f gives relative flatness of O_X (isFlatOver_of_isInvertible). Identify tensor pullback of O_X with the fibre structure sheaf. This gives b : Li_s^* E ≅ R(f_s)_*O_X_s[0].

The nonnegative injective-resolution computation (isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor in the source PlusCompatibility module) gives no negative cohomology of R(f_s)_*O_X_s[0]; transport it through b.

Use the invertible canonical single pullback comparison at O_S and its adjoint unit isomorphism to give j : Li_s^* J ≅ O_Specκ(s)[0]. The canonical single adjunction transpose and the mate definition of base change identify Li_s^*(a) followed by b with j followed by the canonical fibre structure map. The right-derived units move past ordinary exchange by derivedBaseChange_unit_compatibility; the two triangle identities cancel the units and counits.

canonicalDirectImageH0Unit and naturality of the single homology isomorphism identify H0 of the fibre structure map with its ordinary module structure map. Spec κ(s) has only the empty and whole opens: the sheaf map is zero-to-zero on the empty open and the underlying appTop map on the whole open. Thus the IsIso appTop hypothesis gives an isomorphism of module sheaves. Apply H0 to the mate equation and cancel the isomorphisms H0(j), H0(b).

theorem flat_derived_structure_unit_properties
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Flat f] :
    (∀ (s : S) (i : ℤ), i < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) i).obj
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)))))) ∧
    (∀ s : S, IsIso (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).appTop →
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
                (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
              Scheme.Modules.canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f
                (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)))))
